react_native_issues.issue: Expo doctor warning in logs: 'expo-print@55.0.13 expected ~15.0.8; expo-sharing@55.0.18 expected ~14.0.8'. Versions are far ahead of the installed Expo SDK's expected range. PDF export (download-rx-pdf / download-invoice-pdf) may or may not work on native — on web it falls back to window.print which should be fine, but on native this version mismatch can cause runtime failures. Recommend: yarn add expo-print@~15.0.8 expo-sharing@~14.0.8 (or whatever matches the installed expo SDK).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-4 AI-report + PDF features verified at API level and bundle level. ONE high-priority fix was applied by the testing agent: import path in patient/report/[sessionId].tsx. If you add more screens under app/patient/*/*.tsx, remember the relative-path depth is THREE dots-up (../../../) to reach /app/frontend/src. The AI report LLM call takes ~2-6s; leave generous timeouts (60-120s) on report tests. The report endpoint is idempotent (upsert by session_id). For end-to-end UI, prior iteration notes already show that clicking the 'Continue' TouchableOpacity on the initial name-entry screen via Playwright text/role selectors fails — use data-testid='login-continue-button' (if present) or click via page.evaluate with dispatchEvent if needed.
rca_of_issue: RCA: patient/report/[sessionId].tsx lives at depth /app/frontend/app/patient/report/ — 3 levels below /app/frontend/. The author wrote '../../src/lib/api' (2 up) which resolves to /app/frontend/app/src/lib/api and doesn't exist. Expo Router's require.context eagerly imports every file under /app on startup to build the route manifest, so even visiting unrelated routes triggered the Metro resolver, returning a 500 Server Error html page for ALL routes. Reproduction: before fix, `curl -I https://<host>/` returned HTML with 'Unable to resolve module ../../src/lib/api'. Mitigation: change import to '../../../src/lib/api' and `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` to clear Metro's cached error. Verified post-fix via browser: home renders NURTIX hero; /patient/report/<sid> renders report shell.
